en.abdullah-al-shahin: 42 - Muhammad b. Hammam narrated to us, saying: Hamid b. Ziyad al-Kufi narrated to us, saying: al-Hasan b. Muhammad b. Sama'ah narrated to us, saying: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Maythami, from his uncle al-Husayn b. Isma'il, from Ya'qub b. Shu'ayb, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said: "Shall I show you the shirt of the Qaim that he will rise in?" I said: "Yes."

He then called for a container, opened it, and took out a shirt made of coarse fabric. He unfolded it, and there was blood on its left sleeve. He said: "This is the shirt of the Messenger of Allah (saw), which he was wearing on the day his tooth was struck, and it is with this shirt that the Qaim will rise." 

I kissed the blood and placed it on my face. Then Abu Abdullah folded the shirt and put it away.
